canonical_name: No Information Security in Project Management
description: Information security is not integrated into project management regardless of project type.
applicability: Applies when organizations run projects without incorporating security requirements, security reviews, or security acceptance criteria in project planning, execution, and delivery phases.

metadata.detection_notes: Review project templates and methodologies for security integration, assess project charters for security requirements, verify security checkpoints in project gates, check for security acceptance criteria in project deliverables.
